description: This file implements core file system classes and functions, including File, Directory, and Partition, with platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems. It handles file info loading, path normalization, directory creation, existence checks, and partition info retrieval.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with attributes such as name, size, timestamps, and handle, with methods for normalization and info loading.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory with methods for creation, existence check, and path normalization.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Represents a disk partition with methods to read partition info and normalize paths.

methods.name: File::Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a file path, resolving double slashes, dots, and parent directory references.

methods.name: File::LoadFileInfo
methods.description: Loads file attributes, size, and timestamps from the filesystem, platform-specific.

methods.name: Directory::Create
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified path, platform-specific.

methods.name: Directory::CreatePath
methods.description: Recursively creates directories along a path.

methods.name: Partition::LoadPartitionInfo
methods.description: Loads partition size and free space information, platform-specific.
